analysis: CPA-factor RNA expression across fixed state and physical-library inventories
status: written before new factor counts or expression effects were extracted
factor_inventory: Prespecified by user, not selected by expression result; every absent or ambiguous mapping retained explicitly
input_contract: Current v2_primary selected_metacells and frozen_gex counts; join metacell IDs one-to-one and verify totals; use pinned annotation only to replace empty/ID-like gene symbols
normalization: All-gene count CPM per metacell, mean log2(CPM+1) within each state/library; report pooled CPM and detected fraction as auxiliary values
primary_weights: Each qualified physical library has equal weight. Time-equal averaging is sensitivity. Metacells and genes do not constitute biological replicates.

contrasts.P_S: P minus only qualified documented S libraries, selected by sampling-design time D0/source/Stage_I_day_0
contrasts.P_M: P minus M within qualified same physical libraries, then library-equal mean
contrasts.M_S: M minus documented S; descriptive, no same-library source pairing claimed
contrasts.P_S_observed: P minus all observed S; kept separate, especially Liu and Panariello
contrasts.M_S_observed: M minus all observed S; kept separate
contrasts.hN_P_primed_condition: Equal mean of N in GSM4546546 and GSM4546548 minus P in primed GSM4546547; both N conditions also reported separately
contrasts.hN_P_same_library: N minus P in each physical library where both qualified; an auxiliary control, not a replacement for the primed reference

naive_scope: Condition/library comparisons with one sampled physical library per condition; no inference to replicate-level naive state effect
documented_source_scope: The two mouse routes, Xing and two Guan series are primary source contrasts. Other observed-S comparisons are supplementary; series within Guan are not independent studies.
shared_roster_audit: Verify seven user-named genes against the existing 79 P_M-proximal/hN-proximal ortholog overlaps, without assuming all are strict tandem UTR eligible or dual-reference members
verification: Reconstruct available frozen RBP expression for overlapping factors; deterministic tests of gates, CPM denominator, library weights, physical pairing, documented-source separation and naive reference selection; hash all input files
inference: Descriptive factor effects, no DEG p values, no per-metacell pseudoreplication. Record sign and magnitude with weighting sensitivity; do not select a best-performing factor.
mechanistic_boundary: RNA abundance is not CFIm protein/complex activity. APA of a factor's own RNA is not evidence that its expression fell. Failure of RNA direction correspondence cannot exclude activity-based mechanisms. This analysis can evaluate a simple transcript-abundance candidate only.
